context: Headline implementation: choose stream collectors that express map and aggregate semantics without manual mutable loops.

checklist.name: Creates coherent Java 17 artifact
checklist.description: Creates OrderCollectorReport.java with the requested build method, nested records, imports for BigDecimal, List, Map, IntSummaryStatistics, and Java 17-compatible code.

checklist.name: Preserves requested report behavior
checklist.description: Returns the four requested report values with correct handling for empty orders or products, duplicate categories, duplicate item names, and multiple line item quantities.

checklist.name: Uses toMap with merge for cheapest products
checklist.description: Computes cheapestByCategory with Collectors.toMap(Product::category, Function.identity(), BinaryOperator.minBy or an equivalent merge based on Product::price), avoiding duplicate-key failure.

checklist.name: Uses groupingBy with mapping for product names
checklist.description: Computes productNamesByCategory with Collectors.groupingBy(Product::category, Collectors.mapping(Product::name, Collectors.toList())) or equivalent downstream mapping.

checklist.name: Uses flatMap and counting for item sales
checklist.description: Flattens orders to line items and computes salesByItemName with groupingBy(Item::name, counting()) or an equivalent collector, rather than nested manual map updates.

checklist.name: Uses summarizingInt for quantity stats
checklist.description: Computes quantityStats with a flattened item stream and Collectors.summarizingInt(Item::quantity) or an equivalent IntSummaryStatistics stream terminal.

checklist.name: Keeps implementation readable
checklist.description: Keeps helper code small if used and avoids unrelated abstractions or dependencies.
